result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create significant visibility and safety risks for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side are positioned very close to the corner, obstructing the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at this wide residential junction, which may encourage higher speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct sidewalk extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the corners to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.
